name: bb-plugin-ona

bb.name: Ona devboxes [Experimental]
bb.description: Run bb threads in new or existing Ona environments, reached over an SSH reverse tunnel.

description: Run bb threads inside Ona environments (devboxes) over SSH.

scripts.check: scripts/node-check.sh && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && prettier --check . && npm test
scripts.prepare: [ -e .git ] || exit 0; h=$(git config --get core.hooksPath 2>/dev/null); case $h in '') git config core.hooksPath .githooks || echo "core.hooksPath could not be set; this repo's hooks will not run" ;; .githooks|./.githooks|.githooks/) : ;; *) echo "core.hooksPath is $h; this repo's hooks will not run" ;; esac
